simplesect.title: Thread model
simplesect.para: All functions in this file run exclusively on the READER THREAD unless explicitly noted as MESSAGE THREAD in the function documentation. Cross-thread communication is performed through atomic setters and the "writeToHost" / "bell" events in the Processor events map.
